library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 9.1. Import data


# Import full VST matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_data_dir, "vst_oof.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, check.names=F, row.names=1
)

# Import gene ID-to-symbol mapping
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

# Map ENSG IDs to gene symbols
full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol=ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol=ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )

# Import metadata
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import microbe reports
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "microbe_reports_bgfilter.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  filter(
    sample_name %in% metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name
  )

# Import metadata with mNGS hits
metadata_with_mNGS <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    raw_data_dir,
    "metadata_JCI_mNGS_hits_added_06122026.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 9.2. IFN alpha score setup


# 9.2a. Hallmark IFN alpha response gene set


ifn_geneset <- msigdbr(
  species="Homo sapiens",
  collection="H"
) %>%
  filter(
    gs_name == "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE"
  ) %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

# Genes present in RNA data
hallmark_ifn_genes <- intersect(
  ifn_geneset,
  full_vsd$gene_symbol
)

# Genes present in both RNA and protein data
hallmark_ifn_genes_shared <- intersect(
  hallmark_ifn_genes,
  colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
)


# Define RNA and protein colors
omics_colors <- c(
  "RNA"=gene_color,
  "Protein"=protein_color
)






# 9.2b. Build IFN score using all available genes for each modality


build_ifn_score <- function(rpm_df) {

  bind_rows(

    # RNA
    full_vsd %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_ifn_genes
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
        names_to="sample_name",
        values_to="expr"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr))
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="RNA"
      ),

    # Protein
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-patient_id,
        names_to="gene_symbol",
        values_to="expr_log2"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_ifn_genes
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata_df_with_folds %>%
          dplyr::select(
            patient_id,
            sample_name
          ),
        by="patient_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="Protein"
      )

  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      rpm_df,
      by="sample_name"
    )
}

# 9.2d. Compute correlations


compute_cor <- function(
  score_df,
  rpm_col="viral_rpm"
) {

  score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      n_obs=n(),
      pearson_r=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(.data[[rpm_col]] + 1),
          method="pearson"
        )$estimate
      } else {
        NA
      },
      pearson_p=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(.data[[rpm_col]] + 1),
          method="pearson"
        )$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      },
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj=p.adjust(
        pearson_p,
        method="BH"
      ),
      pearson_padj_fmt=signif(
        pearson_padj,
        2
      ),
      y_pos=case_when(
        modality=="RNA" ~ -1.3,
        modality=="Protein" ~ -1.5
      )
    )
}






# 9.2e. Make IFN plot


make_ifn_plot <- function(
  score_df,
  cor_df,
  interaction_p,
  n_cases,
  x_label,
  title,
  subtitle,
  filename
) {

  viral_rpm_plot <- ggplot(
    score_df,
    aes(
      x=log10(viral_rpm + 1),
      y=IFN_score,
      color=modality
    )
  ) +

    # Data points
    geom_point(
      alpha=0.7,
      size=1.8
    ) +

    # Linear regression
    geom_smooth(
      method="lm",
      se=TRUE,
      alpha=0.15,
      fullrange=TRUE,
      xseq=seq(0, 5, length.out=100)
    ) +

    # Zero reference line
    geom_hline(
      yintercept=0,
      linetype="dashed",
      color="grey40"
    ) +

    # Correlation and interaction information
    annotate(
      "text",
      x=0.15,
      y=Inf,
      label=paste0(
        cor_df$modality[
          cor_df$modality=="RNA"
        ],
        ": r = ",
        formatC(
          cor_df$pearson_r[
            cor_df$modality=="RNA"
          ],
          format="f",
          digits=2
        ),
        "\n",
        cor_df$modality[
          cor_df$modality=="Protein"
        ],
        ": r = ",
        formatC(
          cor_df$pearson_r[
            cor_df$modality=="Protein"
          ],
          format="f",
          digits=2
        ),
        "\n",
        ifelse(
          interaction_p < 0.001,
          "Interaction p < 0.001",
          paste0(
            "Interaction p = ",
            formatC(
              interaction_p,
              format="e",
              digits=2
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      hjust=0,
      vjust=1.3,
      size=14 / 2.845,
      lineheight=1.0,
      color="black",
      family="Arial"
    ) +

    # Axes
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim=c(0, 5),
      ylim=c(-2, 2),
      clip="off"
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks=seq(0, 5, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks=seq(-2, 2, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +

    # Colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values=omics_colors,
      breaks=c("RNA", "Protein")
    ) +

    # Labels
    labs(
      x=x_label,
      y="IFN alpha pathway score (z-score)",
      title=title
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_classic(
      base_family="Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.position=c(0.5, 0.06),
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.title=element_blank(),
      plot.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        hjust=0.5,
        face="plain"
      ),
      plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
        10, 10, 10, 10
      )
    )


  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, filename),
    plot=viral_rpm_plot,
    width=6.5,
    height=6.5,
    device=cairo_pdf,
    bg="white"
  )

  return(viral_rpm_plot)
}






# 9.2f. Match mNGS pathogen hits to RPM reports


build_pathogen_rpm <- function(
  metadata_df,
  pathogen_prefix,
  report_df,
  report_category,
  synonyms=list()
) {

  sample_pathogen_map <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(
      LRTI_adjudication=="Definite"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sanitized_name,
      starts_with(pathogen_prefix)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=starts_with(pathogen_prefix),
      values_to="pathogen",
      values_drop_na=TRUE
    ) %>%
    filter(
      pathogen != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sanitized_name,
      pathogen
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  match_pathogen_to_name <- function(pathogen, name) {

    p <- tolower(pathogen)
    n <- tolower(name)

    direct <- grepl(p, n, fixed=TRUE) |
      grepl(n, p, fixed=TRUE)

    syn <- if (
      p %in% names(synonyms)
    ) {
      grepl(
        synonyms[[p]],
        n,
        fixed=TRUE
      )
    } else {
      FALSE
    }

    direct | syn
  }

  candidate_rows <- report_df %>%
    filter(
      category %in% report_category,
      sample_name %in% sample_pathogen_map$sanitized_name
    )

  matched_rows <- sample_pathogen_map %>%
    left_join(
      candidate_rows,
      by=c("sanitized_name"="sample_name"),
      relationship="many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(name)
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      is_match=match_pathogen_to_name(pathogen, name)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(is_match)

  # Warn if an adjudicated pathogen cannot be matched to an RPM report
  unmatched <- sample_pathogen_map %>%
    anti_join(
      matched_rows,
      by=c("sanitized_name", "pathogen")
    )

  if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
    print(unmatched)
    warning(
      nrow(unmatched),
      " sample-pathogen pairs unmatched — check synonyms list"
    )
  }

  matched_rows %>%
    distinct(
      sanitized_name,
      name,
      nt_rpm
    ) %>%
    group_by(sanitized_name) %>%
    summarize(
      rpm=sum(nt_rpm, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      sample_name=sanitized_name
    )
}






# 9.3. Viral RPM versus IFN alpha score plots


# 9.3a. Viral RPM versus IFN alpha score


# Match all adjudicated viral mNGS hits to RPM reports
virus_synonyms <- list(
  "respiratory syncytial virus"="orthopneumovirus"
)

viral_all_hits <- build_pathogen_rpm(
  metadata_df=metadata_with_mNGS,
  pathogen_prefix="JCI_virus_",
  report_df=microbe_reports_bgfilter,
  report_category="viruses",
  synonyms=virus_synonyms
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    viral_rpm=rpm
  )


# Build IFN alpha scores using all available genes
ifn_score_viral_all <- build_ifn_score(
  viral_all_hits
)

cor_viral_all <- compute_cor(
  ifn_score_viral_all
)

interaction_p_viral_all <- summary(
  lm(
    IFN_score ~
      log10(viral_rpm + 1) *
      as.character(modality),
    data=ifn_score_viral_all
  )
)$coefficients[
  "log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA",
  "Pr(>|t|)"
]


# Generate Figure 3F
p3F <- make_ifn_plot(
  score_df=ifn_score_viral_all,
  cor_df=cor_viral_all,
  interaction_p=interaction_p_viral_all,
  n_cases=nrow(viral_all_hits),
  x_label=expression(
    log[10]~"viral RPM (+1)"
  ),
  title="IFN alpha versus viral abundance",
  subtitle=NULL,
  filename="(3F)_Viral_All_vs_IFNa_mNGS.pdf"
)


# Save Figure 3F plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(

# 9.4a. Reactome neutrophil degranulation gene set


neut_geneset <- msigdbr(
  species="Homo sapiens",
  collection="C2",
  subcollection="CP:REACTOME"
) %>%
  filter(
    gs_name == "REACTOME_NEUTROPHIL_DEGRANULATION"
  ) %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

# Genes present in RNA data
hallmark_neut_genes <- intersect(
  neut_geneset,
  full_vsd$gene_symbol
)

# Genes present in both RNA and protein data

# 9.4b. Build neutrophil degranulation score


build_neut_score <- function(rpm_df) {

  bind_rows(

    # RNA
    full_vsd %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_neut_genes
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
        names_to="sample_name",
        values_to="expr"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr))
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        Neut_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="RNA"
      ),

    # Protein
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-patient_id,
        names_to="gene_symbol",
        values_to="expr_log2"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_neut_genes
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata_df_with_folds %>%
          dplyr::select(
            patient_id,
            sample_name
          ),
        by="patient_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        Neut_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="Protein"
      )

  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      rpm_df,
      by="sample_name"
    )
}






# 9.4c. Compute neutrophil-score correlations


compute_cor2 <- function(
  score_df,
  score_col,
  rpm_col="bacterial_rpm"
) {

  score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      n_obs=n(),
      pearson_r=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          .data[[score_col]],
          log10(.data[[rpm_col]] + 1),
          method="pearson"
        )$estimate
      } else {
        NA
      },
      pearson_p=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          .data[[score_col]],
          log10(.data[[rpm_col]] + 1),
          method="pearson"
        )$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      },
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj=p.adjust(
        pearson_p,
        method="BH"
      ),
      pearson_padj_fmt=signif(
        pearson_padj,
        2
      )
    )
}

# 9.4f. Match adjudicated bacterial mNGS hits to RPM reports


bacterial_all_hits <- build_pathogen_rpm(
  metadata_df=metadata_with_mNGS,
  pathogen_prefix="JCI_BF_",
  report_df=microbe_reports_bgfilter,
  report_category="bacteria"
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    bacterial_rpm=rpm
  )


neut_score_bacterial_all <- build_neut_score(
  bacterial_all_hits
)

cor_bacterial_all <- compute_cor2(
  neut_score_bacterial_all,
  score_col="Neut_score"
)






# 9.5. Neutrophil degranulation versus bacterial RPM


# Generate Figure S5
pS5 <- make_neut_plot(
  score_df=neut_score_bacterial_all,
  cor_df=cor_bacterial_all,
  interaction_p=NULL,
  n_cases=nrow(bacterial_all_hits),
  x_label=expression(
    log[10]~"bacterial pathogenic RPM (+1)"
  ),
  title="Neutrophil degranulation versus bacterial abundance",
  filename="(S5)_Bacterial_All_vs_NeutDegran_mNGS.pdf"
)


# Save Figure S5 plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  pS5,
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figureS5.rds")
)






# 9.6. Canonical antibacterial genes versus bacterial RPM


antibacterial_genes <- c(
  "CD177",
  "MMP8",
  "TLR2",
  "TLR4"
)






# 9.6a. Build RNA and protein expression data


antibacterial_df <- bind_rows(

  # RNA
  full_vsd %>%
    filter(
      gene_symbol %in% antibacterial_genes
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
      names_to="sample_name",
      values_to="expr"
    ) %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      modality="RNA"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      gene_symbol,
      expr_scaled,
      modality
    ),

  # Protein
  protein_mat %>%
    { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      patient_id,
      all_of(antibacterial_genes)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=-patient_id,
      names_to="gene_symbol",
      values_to="expr_log2"
    ) %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_df_with_folds %>%
        dplyr::select(
          patient_id,
          sample_name
        ),
      by="patient_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      modality="Protein"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      gene_symbol,
      expr_scaled,
      modality
    )

) %>%
  inner_join(
    bacterial_all_hits,
    by="sample_name"
  )






# 9.6b. Calculate correlations for each gene and modality


antibacterial_cor_df <- antibacterial_df %>%
  group_by(
    gene_symbol,
    modality
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r=cor.test(
      expr_scaled,
      log10(bacterial_rpm + 1),
      method="pearson"
    )$estimate,
    pearson_p=cor.test(
      expr_scaled,
      log10(bacterial_rpm + 1),
      method="pearson"
    )$p.value,
    .groups="drop"
  )


# Calculate RNA versus protein interaction p-value for each gene
antibacterial_interaction_df <- antibacterial_df %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    interaction_p=summary(
      lm(
        expr_scaled ~
          log10(bacterial_rpm + 1) *
          as.character(modality),
        data=cur_data()
      )
    )$coefficients[
      "log10(bacterial_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA",
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ],
    .groups="drop"
  )






# 9.6c. Function to make individual antibacterial gene plots


make_antibacterial_plot <- function(
  gene_name,
  score_df,
  cor_df,
  interaction_df
) {

  gene_df <- score_df %>%
    filter(
      gene_symbol == gene_name
    )

  gene_cor <- cor_df %>%
    filter(
      gene_symbol == gene_name
    )

  gene_interaction <- interaction_df %>%
    filter(
      gene_symbol == gene_name
    ) %>%
    pull(interaction_p)


  bacterial_genes_plot <- ggplot(
    gene_df,
    aes(
      x=log10(bacterial_rpm + 1),
      y=expr_scaled,
      color=modality
      )
    ) +

    # Data points
    geom_point(
      alpha=0.7,
      size=1.8
    ) +

    # Linear regression
    geom_smooth(
      method="lm",
      se=TRUE,
      alpha=0.15,
      fullrange=TRUE,
      xseq=seq(0, 5, length.out=100)
    ) +

    # Zero reference line
    geom_hline(
      yintercept=0,
      linetype="dashed",
      color="grey40"
    ) +

    # Correlation and interaction information
    annotate(
      "text",
      x=0.15,
      y=Inf,
      label=paste0(
        gene_cor$modality[
          gene_cor$modality=="RNA"
        ],
        ": r = ",
        formatC(
          gene_cor$pearson_r[
            gene_cor$modality=="RNA"
          ],
          format="f",
          digits=2
        ),
        "\n",
        gene_cor$modality[
          gene_cor$modality=="Protein"
        ],
        ": r = ",
        formatC(
          gene_cor$pearson_r[
            gene_cor$modality=="Protein"
          ],
          format="f",
          digits=2
        ),
        if (
          length(gene_interaction) > 0 &&
          !is.na(gene_interaction) &&
          gene_interaction < 0.05
        ) {
          paste0(
            "\nInteraction p = ",
            ifelse(
              gene_interaction < 0.001,
              "< 0.001",
              formatC(
                gene_interaction,
                format="f",
                digits=3
              )
            )
          )
        } else {
          ""
        }
      ),
      hjust=0,
      vjust=1.3,
      size=14 / 2.845,
      lineheight=1.0,
      color="black",
      family="Arial"
    ) +

    # Axes
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim=c(0, 5),
      ylim=c(-5, 5),
      clip="off"
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks=seq(0, 5, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks=seq(-5, 5, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +

    # Colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values=omics_colors,
      breaks=c("RNA", "Protein")
    ) +

    # Labels
    labs(
      x=expression(
        log[10]~"bacterial pathogenic RPM (+1)"
      ),
      y="Standardized abundance (z-score)",
      title=paste0(
        gene_name,
        " versus bacterial abundance"
      )
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_classic(
      base_family="Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.position=c(0.5, 0.06),
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.title=element_blank(),
      plot.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        hjust=0.5,
        face="plain"
      ),
      plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
        10, 10, 10, 10
      )
    )

  print(bacterial_genes_plot)

  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, paste0(
    gene_name, "_vs_Bacterial_Pathogen_RPM.pdf")),
    plot=bacterial_genes_plot,
    width=6.5,
    height=6.5,
    device=cairo_pdf,
    bg="white"
  )

  return(bacterial_genes_plot)
}






# 9.6d. Generate all four canonical antibacterial gene plots


pS6_CD177 <- make_antibacterial_plot(
  gene_name="CD177",
  score_df=antibacterial_df,
  cor_df=antibacterial_cor_df,

pS6_MMP8 <- make_antibacterial_plot(

pS6_TLR2 <- make_antibacterial_plot(
